common.tagline: Practice for the Swedish citizenship test
common.machineTranslatedSite: The texts in this language are translated with AI and may contain mistakes. The questions and answers are in Swedish, just like in the test.

disclaimer.text: {brand} is a private practice service. We are not connected to {authorities}. The questions are written by us and based on facts from the study material {material}. They are not questions from the real test.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: Do you have a question, found a mistake or want to work with us? Send an email to the address below and we will reply as soon as we can.

home.titleStart: Practice for the test. Understand the answers in
home.subtitle: Questions in Swedish, just like in the test. Explanations in the language you understand best.
home.demoExplanation: After each answer you see why it is correct and where in {material} you can read more.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to pass the test
home.featureChaptersText: All {n} chapters in {material}, one question at a time.
home.featureExamText: {q} questions in {m} minutes, with a timer.
home.featureReviewText: Questions you answered wrong come back until you know them.
home.featureProgressText: See which chapters you know and which ones you need to study more.
home.featureLanguageText: Read the explanation in your language, and in Swedish if you want.
home.featureCheckedText: Every question has a source and is checked before it is published.
home.priceText: Access to everything. Cancel whenever you want – right away and at no extra cost.
home.faqOfficialA: No. {brand} is a private service for practicing. We are not connected to any government agency. Information about the real test is available from UHR.
home.faqLanguageQ: What language are the questions in?
home.faqLanguageA: The questions and answers are in Swedish, because the test is in Swedish. You can read the explanations in your own language.
home.faqAccountQ: Do I need to create an account?
home.faqAccountA: No, you can start practicing right away. You only give your email when you buy. What you have practiced is saved.
home.faqFormatQ: How many questions does the test have?
home.faqFormatA: The test is in Swedish and has multiple-choice questions with four options. UHR has not yet published the test time and number of questions for the next test. Our practice test has {q} questions in {m} minutes.
home.faqCancelQ: Can I cancel whenever I want?
home.faqCancelA: Yes. There is no commitment period. You cancel with one click under Account, at no extra cost. The cancellation takes effect immediately: your access ends at once and no more payments are taken. Time already paid for is not refunded.
home.guideText: Who has to take the test, when the next test is and how to prepare.
